blocks.text: Architecting a Secure & Compliant Collaboration Platform for a Fast-Growing Bank
Banking
Client
A fast-growing small finance bank focused on serving unserved and underserved segments of society in India.
Ambition
To undergo a complete digital transformation of their core IT infrastructure, replacing a legacy system with a modern, secure, and compliant collaboration platform to support their rapid growth.
Outcome
Architected and deployed a comprehensive cloud collaboration platform that met stringent banking regulations, eliminated downtime, and provided a sound foundation for their digital transformation.
The Ambition
A fast-growing small finance bank focused on serving unserved and underserved segments of society in India.
The Challenge

Their legacy, Linux-based mailing solution was a major liability. It suffered from poor performance, frequent downtime, and had almost no modern security or compliance features. With a banking license came a host of new, strict regulations which their existing system could not meet. The IT team was in a constant state of firefighting, unable to focus on strategic initiatives.
The Architectural Blueprint

As the client transitioned into a formal banking entity, their ambition was to build an IT infrastructure that met the highest standards of security and regulatory compliance. They needed a platform that could not only solve their immediate performance and reliability issues but also provide enterprise-grade features like advanced threat protection, auditable document management, and legal hold capabilities to support their long-term growth.
Ambition, Realized

The new cloud platform immediately solved their core challenges, providing a stable, secure, and compliant environment for all employees. It allowed them to meet all government and banking regulations with confidence. The integrated ATP provided a crucial layer of defense, while the document management and legal hold capabilities satisfied key audit requirements. By suggesting a cloud-native solution, we also eliminated several crores in potential capital investment, allowing them to focus their capital on business growth.
Key Business Impact
Met All Stringent Banking Security & Compliance Requirements
Eliminated System Downtime & Performance Issues
Enabled Advanced Threat Protection & Data Governance
Avoided Significant Capital Expenditure on Infrastructure
Back to Happy Customer Back to Happy Customer
